_doc: Node types that PUBLISH to the public: social posts, blog/CMS pages, community posts,
newsletter sends and social schedulers. Every one of these must have a human.approval
node upstream of it (docs/phase-2-plan.md, decided 2026-10-18). Enforced by the planner's
validator (apps/api services/publishing.go), on every builder save, and again by the
reasoner when a run loads its graph (apps/reasoner reasoner/publishing.py).
Not listed on purpose: Slack / Teams / Discord messages to your own team, email
(output.email, Gmail), CRM updates, docs and sheets — internal or one-to-one, not public.
custom_api_call is listed for publishing pieces because a raw API call can post too.
A Go test checks every entry exists in packages/nodes/pieces/index.json.
